notes.subject: צדיק
notes.rationale: Man i tok: 'kalabus bilong man stret' (KJV), o 'ol i winim ol kalabus long pasin bilong man strong' (JPS) — Hepriu i tanim tok stret i no klia.

notes.subject: long reader
notes.rationale: Ol askim i go long reader — ves 25 (Yahwe i tok) em i bekim.

translation: Bai ol i tekewe ol kaikai bilong pait long man bilong strong? O ol kalabus bilong man i save long stretpela pasin bai ol i karim i go we?

tokens.gloss: bilong man i save long stretpela pasin
